newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Vanik down on budget news.
newsitem.headline: Vanik down on budget news.

text.p: Investment bank Vanik Incorporation Ltd fell four percent, or 75 cents, to 18.75 rupees on turnover of 4,100 shares, as investors sold the scrip following Wednesday's budget, brokers said.
"Vanik has promoted leasing aggressively, and could suffer for it," said a broker dealing with retail investors.

Wednesday's budget said depreciation on leased assets can be set off only against leasing income, as an incentive to specialised leasing firms. Analysts say this may have a short-term negative impact on other financial institutions which do leasing to take advantage of the tax breaks.
